events.head: Start simulator and local centre on fresh throwaway state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; S=/tmp/t235-state; rm -rf $S /tmp/t235-sim.json; (npx wrangler d1 migrations apply revops-centre --local --persist-to $S 2>&1 | tail -3); SIM_PORT=8882 SIM_STATE=/tmp/t235-sim.json nohup python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py >/tmp/t235-sim.log 2>&1 &

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the reminders and follow-ups probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8960 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8882 node scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs > /tmp/t235-probe.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; grep -c "^PASS" /tmp/t235-probe.log; grep "^FAIL" /tmp/t235-probe.log | cut -c1-300 | head -20; grep -iE "replay|nudge|no-show|threshold|second run" /tmp/t235-probe.log | cut -c1-220 | head -20; tail -3 /tmp/t235-probe.log | cut -c1-300

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find the live centre URL and stop the local test stack
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; grep -nE '"pattern"|workers_dev|PUBLIC_URL' wrangler.jsonc | head -5; grep -n "admin.js\|admin-ui" src/index.ts | head -4; pkill -f "wrangler dev --port 8960"; pkill -f "scripts/vendor-sim.py" ; sleep 1; lsof -iTCP:8960 -iTCP:8882 -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | wc -l; rm -rf /tmp/t235-state /tmp/t235-sim.json

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check for other running stacks and confirm the live admin carries the threshold field
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; ps aux | grep -E "vendor-sim|wrangler dev" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2, $11, $12, $13, $14, $15, $16}' | head; echo ---; for p in /admin/admin.js /admin/ui/admin.js /admin-ui/admin.js; do printf "$p "; curl -s "https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev$p?v=$(date +%s)" | grep -c "engagement_nudge_threshold"; done; grep -rn "admin.js" src/*.ts wrangler.jsonc | head -3 | cut -c1-200
